entities.summary: Dahlan Iskan is the former CEO of Indonesian newspaper publisher, Jawa Pos Group. He was the CEO of Indonesia's State Electricity Company (PLN) from 23 December 2009 to 19 October 2011. He was Indonesia's Minister of State-Owned Enterprises in the period October 2011 to October 2014.
